effort: default (no explicit effort override set for this session; permission mode auto)
tools_used: Bash (cat, sed, wc, python3 -I for reading and laying out the JSON inputs, git)
method: Read all 114 entries of patterns_kind_reviewed.json (candidate patterns, then boundary registers, then proxy groups) from a generated full-text layout. Built a cross-family shared-rule index over all 5645 cross-family pairs as a targeting aid, then compared every entry against every entry of the other families by obligation, legitimate cases and kind. Applied the kind rule to exclude proxy-group pairings with other kinds, and the stated exception for candidate-pattern/boundary-register pairs. Wrote the merged obligation sentence and applied the three-part merge test to each candidate pair by hand.
notes: No subagents, workflows, scripts-for-judgement, web access or earlier results were used; scripts only read and laid out the provided files and counted shared rules.
